description.value: You open a rift into Creation's Forge, igniting it into a miniature star that blazes with mighty light. You shed bright light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] (and dim light to the next 30 feet). The light of this spell counts as natural sunlight, and creatures in the area with void healing take @Damage[1[vitality]|options:area-damage] damage whenever you cast or Sustain the spell. After a creature in the area loses HP due to fire damage from any source, it takes @Damage[1[vitality]|options:area-damage] damage.
